description:
[Start here] What's new in Rust: latest update, game-data changes, item store, wipes. One call for "what changed lately": `updates` (Facepunch's five newest posts with the network's write-up when
there is one), `game_data` (the newest build the wiki read from the server files and how many items, recipes,
loot rows... it changed - details at `/game-data-changes/{build}`), `item_store` (this week's limited-time items
and when the store rotates) and `force_wipe` (the last and next monthly force wipe). Cached for five minutes. For 'what changed in the latest update': devblogs, game-data changes, item store, force wipe.
name: whats_new_in_rust
title: What's new in Rust: latest update, game-data changes, item store, wipes
